checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicitly disclosed and never described as official.
All three key areas remain provisional and carry low-confidence usage notes.
The topology-stable partition covers the submitted boundary without independent hand-drawn gaps.
Scaffold design properties and all required design layers were replaced with Civic Apprentice evidence.
Proposal explains sources, standards, depth items, geometry, metrics, assumptions and operating limits.
Offline HTML uses inline CSS/JS and local images only, with no network requests, forms or tracking.

The refined offline exhibit carries the Civic Apprentice Line ethos through a credential route, four civic interfaces, three district duties, five evidence figures, twelve trial cards and a public transcript prototype.
Every scenario declares a human fallback, appeal or stop path.
Formal, background and provisional source uses are separated; external cases support mechanisms only.
Generated assets and public-source use are disclosed; no third-party map tiles, logos or portraits are embedded.
All declared SHA-256 values were refreshed from Git-normalized LF blob content and verified in an isolated checkout against upstream/main@14bce12f.
Official boundary, controls, roads, buildings, heritage and municipal data remain missing; professional recalculation is required.
